rejected_rule.statement: A court should not dismiss an action on the ground of misjoinder of defendants and causes of action without giving an opportunity to the plaintiff to amend his plaint.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Therefore, invoking a question on misjoinder at the appeal stage, does not merit consideration. For these reasons I reject the propositions taken by the Defendants-Appellants in respect of Nos. I, II, and III as stated earlier in this Judgment.
